delivery_methodology: The project will be executed using an AI-enabled agile methodology characterized by short, time-boxed iterations with regular demonstrations and continuous client feedback. This iterative approach allows for incremental delivery of features and early validation of requirements.

AI tools will assist in drafting documentation, generating code snippets, and automating routine tasks, while human experts will review, integrate, and approve all outputs to maintain quality and alignment with client expectations. Scope changes will be managed through controlled processes to ensure project focus and delivery timelines.
executive_summary: Kalinaw Trading Corporation seeks to enhance its human resource management through a comprehensive Human Resource Information System (HRIS) that streamlines employee data management, leave and attendance tracking, and reporting. This initiative is critical to improving operational efficiency, ensuring compliance, and empowering both HR staff and employees with timely and accurate information.

Exist Software Labs proposes a cloud-deployed microservices solution built on a robust Java/Spring Boot backend with a React frontend and PostgreSQL database. The system will be delivered through a structured, iterative process culminating in a fully functional HRIS that meets the client’s business needs and supports mobile and desktop access.
proposed_solution: The proposed HRIS solution integrates key capabilities including employee information management, leave and attendance tracking, payroll interfacing, and comprehensive reporting. HR staff will manage employee records, approvals, and reports, while employees will have self-service access to personal data, leave applications, and payslips. The system supports multi-level approval workflows aligned with the organization’s structure and enforces role-based access control to ensure data security and privacy.

This solution fits Kalinaw Trading Corporation’s operational model by automating routine HR processes, reducing manual errors, and providing real-time insights through dashboards and notifications. The approach emphasizes usability and compliance with company policies, enabling efficient management of leave types, attendance corrections, and document expirations.
technical_architecture: The HRIS is designed as a cloud-hosted microservices architecture leveraging Java and Spring Boot for backend services, React for the user interface, and PostgreSQL for data persistence. The system includes separate environments for development, testing (UAT), and production to ensure quality and stability.

Integration with the payroll system is handled through secure data exchanges, and the architecture supports scalability to accommodate up to 300 concurrent users with high availability targets. Security is enforced through role-based access control, audit trails, and encrypted communications, ensuring compliance with organizational and regulatory requirements.
warranty_support: The solution includes a warranty period during which any defects or issues identified will be promptly addressed and corrected by Exist Software Labs. Defects can be reported through established channels, and the warranty covers all functionality delivered as part of the agreed scope.

Issues arising from misuse, unauthorized modifications, or external factors are excluded from the warranty. Additional support and maintenance services beyond the warranty period are available as separate options to ensure ongoing system performance and updates.
